subject: NSRunLoop.CFRunLoop bridge

observation.summary: Runtime probe iterates class_copyMethodList() on NSRunLoop. The NSRunLoop bridge API surface is observed as both instance and class methods: -getCFRunLoop (instance) plus +currentRunLoop and +mainRunLoop (class methods), together with the canonical -run, -runUntilDate:, -runMode:beforeDate: instance methods and -acceptInputForMode:beforeDate: / -addPort:forMode: / -addTimer:forMode: / -performSelector:target:argument:order:modes: / -performBlock: family for dispatching work into the loop.
observation.raw_output_excerpt:
=== NSRunLoop ===
  -  getCFRunLoop
  -  run
  -  runUntilDate:
  -  runMode:beforeDate:
  -  runMode:untilDate:
  -  acceptInputForMode:beforeDate:
  -  addPort:forMode:
  -  addTimer:forMode:
  -  removePort:forMode:
  -  removeTimer:forMode:
  -  performSelector:target:argument:order:modes:
  +  currentRunLoop
  +  mainRunLoop

claim: NSRunLoop publishes a public -getCFRunLoop instance method that returns the embedded CFRunLoopRef, plus +currentRunLoop / +mainRunLoop class factories; this is the documented NSRunLoop ↔ CFRunLoop bridge entry point.

cross_reference.label: RunLoop.swift Swift reimplementation (no CFRunLoop bridge; -getCFRunLoop is private/Apple-only)
